description: Use when: what did this BNB wallet buy recently, and was it early? Lists recent BNB Chain token receipts from a pool, router or other contract: token, time, size, whether the buy was in the first blocks of a four.meme or PancakeSwap launch, and whether that launch ran and is still trading. Same free-RPC window of about 2 days, reported as lookback_hours. Cached. Unknown prices or logs stay null and partial. Not advice. Costs $0.02.
name: bsc_smart_money_wallet
